prompt: We found two problems in the inventory ledger (src/ledger.mjs). First, when a warehouse ships the last units of an item it throws: I received 5 of AB-12, then shipped 5, and got "insufficient stock for AB-12: 5 on hand, 5 requested". Shipping exactly what is on hand should work and leave a balance of 0. Second, ledger.balance("ab-12") returns 0 after ledger.receive("AB-12", 4), even though SKUs are supposed to be case insensitive and ignore surrounding spaces everywhere else in the ledger. Please fix both. `npm test` runs the tests in test/ (one of them fails right now); make sure they pass.
